analysis:
The change is documentation-only: docs/provider/cli-reference.md. The visible patch excerpt is truncated, but the base and head units I was given show no source, config or code changes. The changes I could see: the `sandbox` row (head line 182) now says `setup` requires approval from the Darkbloom Sandbox waitlist; the `waitlist` row (head line 191) is a new subcommand with per-account waitlists; the range map also lists changed regions around head 1360-1385, 1635-1724 and others, which are outside the supplied excerpts.

Threat-model relevance:
- TB-013, A-019 and T-061 cover `darkbloom sandbox setup` downloading and running the add-on installer. The waitlist-approval language is described as a gate, but the doc does not say whether it is enforced client-side or by the sandbox service. It is not a local trust boundary and does not weaken the TB-013 integrity controls (TLS, signature checks), and no installer behavior is documented as changed.
- The base-text units (lines 2817-3187) contain unchanged content: environment passthrough, the App Attest worker flag, cache and SSD-prefix settings (T-041), and watchdog and fan runtime constants. None of it is in the changed ranges, and the base-side numbers do not align with the head.
- The documented DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE defaults and the 30-minute TTL remain consistent with T-041.

I could not verify whether `waitlist` and the sandbox gate are enforced in code. The head ranges 1360-1385 and 1635-1724 were not supplied, so I did not review them, and I treat the lack of that text as a coverage limit. The remaining integration question is whether the new `waitlist` command (Waitlist/WaitlistCommand.swift) handles the account credential (A-008) safely. That code is not in this batch, so it belongs to any pass covering the source files.
